build_encoder_with_vit_backbone: build a pretrained ViT encoder and scratch layers using _make_encoder with backbone vitb16_384
create_scratch_conv_layers: create a scratch module with four Conv2d layers from in_shape to out_shape using _make_scratch
build_efficientnet_backbone: build an EfficientNet-Lite3 backbone from a torch.hub model using _make_pretrained_efficientnet_lite3
create_residual_conv_unit: create a ResidualConvUnit module with two 3x3 convolutions and ReLU for feature refinement
build_feature_fusion_block: build a FeatureFusionBlock_custom that fuses multi-scale features with residual units and bilinear upsampling
